scoring_notes: Framework-level finding: the cohort metadata for J names defense programs (hypersonic test infrastructure, NNSA Nuclear Security Enterprise sustainment, AF Test Range modernization) that BELONG TO AMENTUM (AMTM), not Jacobs Solutions (J), post the September 2024 Reverse Morris Trust spin. The FY2025 10-K of continuing-operations Jacobs makes NO claims about any Pentagon Program Element. Therefore the J-Book DIVERGENCE pattern has no narrative load to test for J; the framework's correct read is that J has minimal residual DoD/J-Book exposure and the named programs migrated to AMTM.

pentagon_jbook contractor-name lookup for 'Jacobs Technology', 'Jacobs Solutions', and even 'Amentum' all return NOT_FOUND because the corpus's contractor index is sparse (only primary_contractors[] populated for a handful of PEs). However, the by_entity.json side-channel index DOES show JACOBS TECHNOLOGY INC. as performer on PE 0604879C and JACOBS TECHNOLOGY IRES INC. as contractor on PE 0604102C. Both PEs are FUNDED_SHRINKING in FY26 but they ride to Amentum, not J.

USAspending corroborates the entity migration: 'Jacobs Engineering Group' / 'Jacobs Technology' historical DoD awards (1,249 awards, $2.8B) are now showing Recipient Name = 'AMENTUM TECHNOLOGY, INC.' on the top awards including the MDA BMDS RDT&E task order (Award HQ079618F8003, $617M) directly mapping to PE 0604879C. 'Jacobs Solutions' returns 0 DoD awards.

summary.framework_verdict: J is the WRONG TICKER for the J-Book divergence cohort post-2024 spin. The named programs (hypersonic test infrastructure, NNSA Nuclear Security Enterprise sustainment, AF Test Range modernization) and the J-Book PEs tagged to Jacobs Technology (0604879C MDA Sensor Test FUNDED_SHRINKING -33%; 0604102C Guam Defense Development FUNDED_SHRINKING -69%) all migrated to AMENTUM (AMTM) in September 2024. Continuing-ops Jacobs is now a civil infrastructure / water / life-sciences / PA Consulting business with 8% federal-government revenue and no named Pentagon programs in its forward narrative. The divergence pattern, if it exists, applies to AMTM. For J: minimal direct J-Book risk; indirect $227M FY25 MTM loss on retained AMTM stake is the only material defense-driven hit.
